groups.name: Later-owner/shape preflight refusal
groups.scenario: One shared asset; valid first owner, stale/foreign/faulted/uninitialized later participant or invalid later shape.
groups.requiredObservation: Before/cache/allMaterials/flags, every adapter cache, native setter counts, owner phases and leases unchanged; no early owner writes.

groups.name: Five value entry invalid inputs and no-op guards
groups.scenario: Every scalar and setValues: NaN, infinities, boxed/coercible values, float32 overflow, negative friction/restitution, nonzero rolling/spinning, same-value write during protected phase.
groups.requiredObservation: Reject before cache/event/native; preserve argument evaluation boundary and exact setValues reorder; no hidden restitution upper bound.

groups.name: Public removal cannot sever physics
groups.scenario: off exact/type, removeAll key/target, targetOff, clear, callback-table query overrides; edit again after removal.
groups.requiredObservation: Public notifications may disappear; private physical leases and one native update per target remain. No duplicate old internal listener.

groups.name: Public once/manual/recursive emit
groups.scenario: Once auto-off, invalid-target auto-off, manual and recursive EVENT_UPDATE, user emit override.
groups.requiredObservation: No extra private/native application; public once semantics preserved; recursive callback failure recorded without unknown native replay.

groups.name: Default plus explicit and inactive consumers
groups.scenario: Default and two explicit colliders share an asset; a disabled collider keeps same asset; one binding replaced/cloned/destroyed.
groups.requiredObservation: One world scope; correct independent refcounts; no inherited/explicit double application; inactive cached geometry updated with zero shape writes.

groups.name: Registration/generation/capability reentry
groups.scenario: Copy getter catches register/dispose/replacement reentry; stale/copied/wrong-receiver/foreign/replayed apply capability.
groups.requiredObservation: Outer copy/admission fails when latched; no cache/native/sequence side effects; independent leases preserved.

groups.name: Public listener physics reentry
groups.scenario: After private success listener attempts material/identity/Node/System config, step and destroy, catches some, throws in separate case.
groups.requiredObservation: Forbidden mutations leave no cache/native effect; no owner phase reset. Caught unrelated guard refusal may allow outer success; uncaught failure faults full roster.

groups.name: First and later native unknown mutation
groups.scenario: Artificial throw before/after underlying setter; first and later native targets.
groups.requiredObservation: Per-target not-entered/entered-unknown/returned/verified facts; stop further writes; fault all original participants; retain JS cache; no reverse/retry.

groups.name: Returned native then readback/cache failure
groups.scenario: Artificial getShapeMaterial mismatch/throw, prepared adapter cache application throw, later owner commit throw.
groups.requiredObservation: Returned native fact survives, actual caches/readback failures distinct, no restoration fiction; all participants fault.

groups.name: Public callback and cleanup falsy failures
groups.scenario: Throw undefined, null, zero after coefficient/native commit, followed by fault reporter and scope disposal errors.
groups.requiredObservation: Original first thrown value identity retained with hasFailure flag; every independent cleanup attempted; unresolved leases truthful.

groups.name: Identity commit and initial subscription failure
groups.scenario: Same object, equal-id distinct assets, null branches, real clone return, clone throw, provisional initialization, private lease publication failure.
groups.requiredObservation: Actual private cache identity only; candidate not promoted on failed publication; all old/candidate/actual cleanup refs retained; no clone getter for discovery.

groups.name: Owned destroy and already-pending asset adoption
groups.scenario: Destroy asset with live/provisional/closed-unresolved lease; assign already ToDestroy/Destroyed asset; destroy after last verified release.
groups.requiredObservation: Owned refusal before flags/deferred queue/allMaterials; pending asset refused before native; zero-owner original destroy preserved.

groups.name: Collider and System terminal cleanup
groups.scenario: Retire one shared binding, close world, inject private lease retirement/public legacy off/adapter destroy failures.
groups.requiredObservation: All stages independently attempted; second owner lease intact; stale System never drives later selector world; reporter generation stays exact.

groups.name: Unknown world teardown
groups.scenario: destroyWorld throws with uncertain native outcome, then public asset update and repeated close.
groups.requiredObservation: Execution authority revoked; unresolved reference/blocker retained, no reapply/retry/false zero-native report; other owners not silently treated as unaffected.

groups.name: Mixed backend and no-owner compatibility
groups.scenario: Builtin/Cannon-only legacy entries; a material with Box3D and blocker-only nonparticipant; fresh-runtime vs late-observation setup.
groups.requiredObservation: No-owner legacy order unchanged; mixed participant rejected before any cache/native write or full boundary explicitly remains blocked; no scan-table completeness claim.

groups.name: Pause and integration fence regression
groups.scenario: Owner enable=false/autoSimulation=false; asset updates at idle and from collection/solve/writeback/dispatch; counter/budget exhaustion.
groups.requiredObservation: No queue consumption, target release, producer enable, clock change or unified activation; active-phase refusal before effects, prepared metadata exhaustion before publication.
